structured.answer: I didn't choose anything. I'll ask you, or ask at the bank, because the page is a long dark list of percentages from companies I've never heard of (מור, אנליסט, מיטב), and nowhere does it tell me which track is as safe as a deposit. The only thing I took away is that the yearly fee is about half a percent to 0.7% everywhere, and that "כספי (שקלי)" and "אג"ח" have 0% in shares.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the rows of buttons under "במה הכסף מושקע"
stuck.why: There are about twenty buttons, like "עוקב מדד s&p 500", "כספי (שקלי)", "משולב סחיר" and "הלכה". None of them says "safe" or "like a deposit". I left it on "הכל" and didn't know what to press.
The first rows, with the lowest fee (0.54%), have no company name above them that I could see. I don't know whose money that is.
Many rows say "פחות מ־3 שנים" instead of a number. It also says "לפני דמי ניהול", so I don't know what I would actually get.
Every company repeats the same kind of names, with dozens of numbers and coloured circles. By the sixth screen I was tired and stopped.

used: The heading "כל המסלולים בכל החברות" and the sentence that "דמי הניהול הם הממוצע שנגבה בפועל ב־2025"
The highlighted product button "קופת גמל להשקעה 143"
The "דמי ניהול" column, roughly 0.54% to 0.73% "מהחיסכון" and 0% "מההפקדות"
The "מניות" percentages next to each track, especially 0% for "כספי (שקלי)" and "אג"ח סחיר"
The company bars "מור", "אנליסט" and "מיטב" with their fee range
skimmed: The 3-year and 5-year return numbers on the share tracks (24%, 26%: too big and tempting, I didn't trust them)
The small links "מקורו / מחושב / הזנתה" under the introduction
skipped: The coloured ring charts next to each row
The search box and the "קיבוץ לפי" switch
The "מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה" link (I didn't open it, though maybe I should have)
Screens 7 to 15, which I never reached
The top menu items (מדריך, השוואה למטרה, השקעה במדד)
unsure_meaning: s&p 500 / S&P500 (I read it letter by letter)
מט"ח (the numbers next to it, like 99%)
"פחות מ־3 שנים" in place of a return
101% מניות (how can it be more than everything?)
Teal versus yellow in the circles, which I can't tell apart well on the dark background
The dotted underlines under the numbers
The tag "חדש" and the orange ! next to "עוד לא דווח"
not_found: A sentence saying which track is safe, or as safe as a פיקדון
A comparison with what a deposit gives
What I would get in shekels after the fee
Who runs the 0.54% tracks at the top of the list

findings.what: There is no plain sentence anywhere saying which tracks are low-risk or how they compare with a bank deposit. The first screen opens with S&P and stock indexes, and someone like me feels this isn't for them.
A huge table that repeats for every company: about 8 numbers per row and a ring chart. It makes me anxious, and I gave up after six screens.
The dark background with grey and small writing is hard to read even when enlarged, especially the column headings and "3 שנים / 5 שנים".
The companies are names I don't know (מור, אנליסט, מיטב), and no bank appears. I wouldn't hand money to strangers.
An orange warning, "נתוני הרשות לא עודכנו מאז ספטמבר 2026", made me wonder whether the numbers can be trusted.
The returns are "לפני דמי ניהול", and many say "פחות מ־3 שנים", so I can't see what I would actually earn.
I couldn't see the company heading for the first group of rows.
The two colours in the circles look alike to me.
